entries.text: The published corpus adds 58 replacement local bundles across ClickHouse Local, DataFusion, and SQLite with raw-text DuckDB source dialect translation, resolving superseded SQL translations from prior releases. 44 ran on SQLGlot fork 30.24.0.17 and 14 (SQLite and DataFusion Read Primitives, DataFusion ClickBench and TPC-DI, ClickHouse Local CoffeeShop and TPC-DI) on 30.25.0.2.
